name: Assamite Sorcery Rituals — Intermediate — Blood's Cry for Vengeance

system.description:
The Nosferatu claim that when one Assamite dies, the whole clan knows within a fortnight — and they are not far wrong. This ritual binds two or more willing participants in a subtle psychic bond that has no ordinary effect and cannot be detected, but which instantly informs every bound participant of a fellow's death, along with a flash of the dying vampire's emotional state (usually enough to know whether she died honorably or by betrayal). Every loyal Assamite is bound to the Eldest and to one another by this ritual upon their first pilgrimage to Alamut.

System: Each participant (up to the caster's Occult rating) contributes two Blood Traits into a wooden bowl; the caster need not be one of them, though she counts against the limit if she is. Over the course of an hour the blood is brought to a boil over an open fire while the participants meditate together on their bond. When the last of the blood boils away and the challenge succeeds, all participants are permanently linked as described above, with no known method of severance.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
system.duration: Permanent, until death of a participant
